documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Canarys Automations reported its highest-ever financial performance for FY26, crossing INR100 crores on a standalone basis and reaching close to INR200 crores on a consolidated basis. Management highlighted a strategic pivot toward becoming an AI-native engineering and solution resilience platform, driven by their proprietary CAR framework and AI products such as AURYIS, ClubAce, and Scholaris. The acquisition of Fortira Inc. in April 2025 expanded their North American presence and capabilities. The company expects EBITDA and PAT margins to improve over the next 12 to 24 months, supported by agentic AI adoption, scaling product revenues, and easing integration costs.

guidance.claim: The company targets a revenue growth of 20% as a bare minimum for the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: It should be. We are targeting a little higher as well. But at a bare minimum, yes, 20% is quite achievable, but we are targeting for higher growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the pipeline is pretty strong and they are working on multiple project opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Pipeline is pretty strong. We are working on multiple project opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for digital transformation is driving growth across diverse industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We achieved a strong business momentum in H1 FY '26 with a successful delivery of 164 projects across diverse industries such as IT, BFSI, healthcare, logistics, etc., underscoring the growth demand for digital transformation.

capex_expansion.claim: Canarys acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025 to strengthen its presence in North America.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025, significantly strengthening Canarys' presence in the North American technology services market.

capex_expansion.claim: The strategic acquisition of Fortira for a 51% stake was completed in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed this acquisition in April 2025 for a 51% stake, underscored our transition from a local solutions company to a global, active, innovation-driven technology enterprise.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins moderated during the year due to strategic investments in talent, technology, and the integration of Fortira.
margins_costs.quote: Serving customers in 10-plus countries, while consolidated margins moderated during the year, this was a conscious outcome of our strategic investments in talent, technology and integration of Fortira.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that integration costs and talent investments that moderated margins in FY26 are largely onetime in nature.
margins_costs.quote: And third, the integration costs and talent investments that moderated margins in FY26, including the Fortira integration are largely onetime in nature.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 17% on a standalone basis through operational efficiencies and execution excellence.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margin improved to 17% through operational efficiencies, execution excellence, and AI-enabled productivity initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic growth investments and integration costs led to a moderation in consolidated EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic growth investments, including integration costs and talent onboarding, led to a moderation in EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to labour code provisions.
margins_costs.quote: However, PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to the implementation of labour code provisions.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for H1 FY '26 stood at INR 13 crores with a 13% margin, reflecting a slight expected dip due to strategic investments.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA stood at INR 13 crores with a 13% margin. There is a slight dip in margin, which was expected as we made strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at approximately INR441 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, giving us healthy revenue visibility for the years ahead.

orders_capacity.claim: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores to the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores, nearly doubling from INR105 crores in FY '25.

orders_capacity.claim: Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores to the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The consolidated order book for FY26 stood at Rs 4,409 Mn including Fortira's order book.
The total order book stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, consisting of INR 151 crores from technology solutions and INR 57 crores from water resource management.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book now stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, out of which INR 151 crores from technology solutions vertical, a significant rise from INR 105 crores in FY '25, and INR 57 crores from water resource management.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, reflecting a conservative and healthy capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: On the balance sheet side, we remain disciplined. Our debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, underlying our conservative and healthy capital structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profit after tax growth was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR10 crores. Growth here was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Water resource management projects involve longer payment cycles, leading to a more focused approach on opportunities offering speed, scale, and better commercial outcomes.
risks_headwinds.quote: These projects have strengthened our expertise, but given longer payment cycles, we now take a more focused approach choosing opportunities that offer speed, scale, and better commercial outcomes.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects margin correction and traction building for Fortira to take 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: The correction will definitely take about 12 to 18 months. And Fortira has already seen good traction with this.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the business model pivot toward higher-margin product and AI revenue to show in the numbers over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Put simply, we are deliberately pivoting our business model through AI and our product portfolio toward a structurally high margin, more profitable and faster-growing company, and we expect the numbers to show it over the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: One of the key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of the team in AI, ML, and data skills.
management_commitments.quote: One of our key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of our team in AI, ML, and data skills to strengthen our leadership in emerging technologies.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
